items.observation: RenderHighlightOverlay adds the controller listener in the constructor and removes it in detach; there is no attach override. If the same render object reattaches after detach (for example when an ancestor is moved to another parent with a GlobalKey), it no longer repaints on controller changes. The controller setter also subscribes while detached.
items.proposed_fix: Move addListener into attach (after super.attach) and keep detach symmetric. Let the setter subscribe only while attached. Test: move FindInPageScope to another parent with a GlobalKey, then call search() and verify that the overlay repaints (red first).
items.closure_criteria: RenderHighlightOverlay adds the controller listener in attach, removes it in detach and lets the setter subscribe only while attached. A test that moves FindInPageScope to another parent with a GlobalKey and calls search() shows the overlay repainting.

items.observation: setOpenCloseHandlers, setDiscovery, registeredSources and discoveredSources exist only for FindInPageScope and the highlight overlay wiring, but they are public members of the exported FindInPageController. Application code can call them and 2.x semver is bound.
items.proposed_fix: Record it and plan it for the next major release: mark the members @internal (package:meta) or move them into a wiring object inside src. Until then add the dartdoc note 'for FindInPageScope, not for application code' and add no new ones (FIP-02).
items.closure_criteria: The four wiring members are marked @internal or moved into an unexported wiring object under lib/src, and the dartdoc note is in place until then. No public member of FindInPageController exists only to wire the scope or the overlay.

items.kind: import cycle / dependency inversion principle (DIP) violation
items.observation: controller.dart imports auto_discovery.dart only for the `source is RenderedTextSource` special case. auto_discovery.dart in turn imports controller.dart for FindableSource, that is, there is a cycle. The core model depends on a concrete source subtype.
items.proposed_fix: Define an unexported single-method 'bring match on screen' interface (in controller.dart or a separate src file). Let RenderedTextSource implement it, let the controller ask `is <interface>` and drop the auto_discovery import. Behavior does not change; test/show_on_screen_test.dart acts as the safety net.
items.closure_criteria: controller.dart no longer imports auto_discovery.dart and reaches the bring-match-on-screen behavior through an unexported interface. test/show_on_screen_test.dart passes unchanged.

items.observation: The bring-into-view animation (200 ms, Curves.easeInOut, 0.3 viewport alignment) is written as separate literals in three places.
items.proposed_fix: Define a single private constant set inside src and let the three call sites use it. Behavior does not change.
items.closure_criteria: One private constant set in lib/src defines the 200 ms duration, the easeInOut curve and the 0.3 viewport alignment, and the three call sites use it. flutter test shows no behavior change.

items.observation: Two `// ignore: use_setters_to_change_properties` comments stand without a written reason.
items.proposed_fix: Add a reason on the same line (public API; converting to a setter would be a breaking change) or remove the suppressions when debt B2 closes.
items.closure_criteria: Each ignore: use_setters_to_change_properties carries a written reason naming the public API constraint, or the suppressions disappear when the members leave the public API.

items.observation: The tests print diagnostics to stdout and suppress avoid_print in five places.
items.proposed_fix: Move the details into expect(..., reason: ...); delete the prints and the ignores.
items.closure_criteria: test/fold_table_test.dart contains no print calls and no avoid_print ignores. Each former print detail appears as a reason argument on an expect.

items.observation: `_clients` and `_listener` are process-wide mutable state. Their readers, writers and lifetimes are undocumented.
items.proposed_fix: Write `///` docs for both fields: install/uninstall reference counting, reads by the keydown listener, removal when the last client detaches. The code does not change.
items.closure_criteria: The _clients and _listener fields in web_find_intercept_web.dart carry /// docs stating the install and uninstall reference counting, the readers and the removal when the last client detaches.

items.observation: The `0x00C0` literal repeats the `_firstFoldable` constant at :118.
items.closure_criteria: text_fold.dart uses the _firstFoldable constant in place of the 0x00C0 literal at line 226. test/fold_table_test.dart still passes.

items.observation: _recompute does three jobs in 53 lines: merging discovery results, the scan loop over folded text, and the active index policy. The scan is a pure operation yet cannot be tested without a widget.
items.proposed_fix: Extract the scan loop into a pure function in text_fold.dart (folded text + needle → list of ranges) and add unit tests next to fold_table_test. Let the controller only dispatch results.
items.closure_criteria: The scan over folded text is a pure function in lib/src/text_fold.dart with unit tests beside fold_table_test.dart. _recompute only merges discovery results and applies the active index policy.

items.observation: pubspec declares Flutter 3.22.0 as the minimum (sdk ^3.4.0) but CI runs on stable only. An API use that fails to compile on the base version goes unnoticed.
items.proposed_fix: Add 3.22.0 to the matrix as in text_autosize; let the format check run on stable only.
items.closure_criteria: The CI matrix runs the format, analyze and test gate on Flutter 3.22.0 as well as stable. The format check still runs on stable only.
